text.hi: किताब: यह बातचीत नाटक की तरह करो। Tinku अशोक बनेगा, तुम राजू बनो।
text.hinglish: Kitaab: yeh baatcheet naatak ki tarah karo. Tinku Ashok banega, tum Raju bano.
text.en: The book: act out this dialogue. Tinku is Ashok, you are Raju.

turns.tinku: Hello, Raju! Did you enjoy the lesson, ‘Measure for Measure’?

meaning.hi: हैलो राजू! क्या तुम्हें पाठ ‘मेज़र फ़ॉर मेज़र’ अच्छा लगा?
meaning.hinglish: Hello Raju! Kya tumhe paath ‘Measure for Measure’ achha laga?

replies.say: Yes, very much. A painter was appointed as an administrator.

meaning.hi: हाँ, बहुत। एक चित्रकार को प्रशासक बना दिया गया।
meaning.hinglish: Haan, bahut. Ek chitrakaar ko prashaasak bana diya gaya.

turns.tinku: Yes, it is really a funny thing.

meaning.hi: हाँ, यह सच में मज़ेदार बात है।
meaning.hinglish: Haan, yeh sach mein mazedaar baat hai.

replies.say: But Tenali Raman was a very intelligent person.

meaning.hi: पर तेनाली रामन बहुत समझदार थे।
meaning.hinglish: Par Tenali Raman bahut samajhdaar the.

turns.tinku: He was really a genius. Only he could complain to the king against the chief minister.

meaning.hi: वे सच में प्रतिभाशाली थे। सिर्फ़ वही राजा से मुख्यमंत्री की शिकायत कर सकते थे।
meaning.hinglish: Woh sach mein pratibhaashaali the. Sirf wahi raja se mukhyamantri ki shikaayat kar sakte the.

replies.say: So Tenali Raman appointed a carpenter as a cook.

meaning.hi: तो तेनाली रामन ने एक बढ़ई को रसोइया बना दिया।
meaning.hinglish: To Tenali Raman ne ek badhai ko rasoiya bana diya.

turns.tinku: The king understood the problem at once.

replies.say: But it was good that Raja Varma resigned from his post himself.

meaning.hi: पर अच्छा हुआ कि राजा वर्मा ने ख़ुद पद छोड़ दिया।
meaning.hinglish: Par achha hua ki Raja Varma ne khud pad chhod diya.

turns.tinku: So it's a very good lesson. Isn't it?

meaning.hi: तो यह बहुत अच्छा पाठ है, है ना?
meaning.hinglish: To yeh bahut achha paath hai, hai na?
